title: Sequence M3 typed local application boundary and Workbench implementation
goal: Create exact M3 child Plans while keeping Target writes composition selection CI activation publication and merge outside this program.
acceptanceCriteria: Four child Plan pairs cover the typed service boundary, Setup and protection previews, authority and lifecycle handoffs, and the secured Companion Workbench.
Every child declares exact code and test paths, risks, dependencies, boundaries and stop resume recovery behavior.
No product code, Target, workflow, ruleset, trusted-test inventory, installed selection, release or remote state changes occur in this planning checkpoint.
risks: A planning checkpoint could be mistaken for implemented Setup or protection authority.
decisions: Use four ordered child checkpoints and keep every Target, trust, selection and remote apply operation separate.
validationCommands: Test-Json for all M3 implementation Plan JSON files
